_comment: MEASUREMENT build of mi_rng: same code and hook, compiled with -DMI_RNG_SAMPLE_TAP so every raw
noise record is copied to a ring buffer at SRAM 0x18005000 (claim mi_rng_tap_buf) for a live-RAM capture.
It REPLACES the production build (same sectors); it is for measuring entropy, never for use. See README.md.
name: mi_rng_tap
description: mi_rng with the raw ADC/timer samples tapped to SRAM 0x18005000 for entropy measurement (not for use).

splices.name: mi_draw
splices.why: Each of the six iterations of the MI fill loop calls lcg_rand_next and stores the low byte (st.b r0,(r5,0) at 0x0305caf0). The caller uses only r0, r4, r5 after the call, and r4/r5 are callee-saved, so a handler that returns the byte in r0 is a drop-in.
